text:
maria: Quick design check — flagged some accessibility and copy nits on the API keys rotate/revoke modal after the Friday usability pass. Posting screenshots in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/keyflows -> can folks skim?
ashish: saw. main concern was the warning copy — feels too techy. current: ‘Rotating will invalidate current tokens and disrupt active sessions.’ suggestion: ‘Rotating this key will stop any services using it. Create a new key and update your apps before rotating.’ shorter and action-oriented.
sam: agree w/ copy tweak. also the modal only shows masked key and a small copy button — keyboard users can't focus the copy btn reliably. I tried tabbing and it jumps over the icon.
tayla: thanks — that's the important a11y piece. we need the copy button to be keyboard reachable and have aria-labels for screen readers: `aria-label="Copy API key"` and an `aria-live` announcement when copied. Also ensure the masked key field has `role="textbox"` and `aria-readonly="true"` so VO announces it.
maria: good call. ashish — can we also avoid forcing a destructive tone in the header? current header: ‘Rotate key — destructive’. maybe use neutral: ‘Rotate key’ and surface the consequence text below.
ashish: yeah ok. another nit: the confirm checkbox in revoke flow says ‘I understand this is irreversible’. that's vague. propose: ‘I understand services using this key will stop working immediately’ — clearer on impact.
sam: UX for reveal flow: currently we show the full key only for 10s then auto-mask. but keyboard users can't see that countdown. suggest: replace visual countdown with a simple ephemeral banner that reads ‘Key visible for 10 seconds — press Esc to hide’ and ensure Esc hides it via keyboard handler.
tayla: we should also consider color contrast for the warning strip (yellow). current text contrast falls below 4.5:1 on small text. either darken text or increase weight.
maria: let's standardize: warning strip uses #4a2f00 on white bg or change background to a darker amber. assignable items?
ashish: I'll update Figma copies + component states this afternoon. small code example for the copy button aria: ```html
<button aria-label="Copy API key" aria-live="polite">Copy</button>
<input type="text" value="sk_live_..." aria-label="API key" readonly />
```
umaria: tiny: when rotating we show a snackbar 'Key rotated' but no link to the new key or KB. should we include a CTA: 'View new key' that opens the token drawer? privacy implications but helpful for devs.
sam: agree but make it ephemeral and only for the user who performed the rotation. backend will log the event.
tayla: accessibility for modal focus: trap focus within modal, return focus to the originating `Rotate` button after close, and ensure the heading has `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`.
ashish: on keyboard flow, I'll add explicit focus styles for the copy icon and primary CTA. also will add hidden visually text for screen readers: `span.sr-only` that reads 'New key copied to clipboard' when copy completes.
maria: one more product ask — in empty state for keys list we currently show 'No keys yet' with tiny copy. can we make it actionable: big CTA 'Create your first API key' and a short note on permissions: 'You can scope keys to project and role.'
sam: +1. and add a tiny inline example of least privilege: 'Use scoped keys for runtime features, admin keys for infra tasks' — keeps it educational.
ui-deploy-bot: Deployed design token update branch `keyflow/a11y-copy` -> PR #582 ready for review (https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/582) :rocket:
ashish: thanks bot — pinging @tayla for a11y review once I push the Figma updates.
tayla: will review tomorrow AM, but looks promising. can we add unit test for focus trap? I can write quick test steps.
maria: lovely — let's follow up in the PR thread. :thumbsup:
